prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-bulrathi-figure.png. Requested dimensions 2048x3072, 2:3. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
8 · Bulrathi — Ursa — forest green / brown
Game role: unmatched ground fighters. Strengths: troops fight with a huge bonus, cheap construction and weapons research. Weakness: poor computers. Slow to anger, slower to befriend — gardeners at heart who tame hostile worlds.
Body & dress: hulking bear-people: dense brown-black grizzled fur, small intelligent eyes, heavy brow, wide muzzle with tusks, enormous shoulders. Plain trench-soldier greatcoats in green-olive wool and leather, brass buckles, rows of campaign medals; practical gardening tools sometimes tucked in a belt.
Surroundings: a fortress-farm: stone and timber with riveted steel, greenhouse domes of hardy plants, bunkers beside terraced gardens, wood-fired iron stoves, maps of campaigns pinned beside seed catalogues. Cold, snowy light through thick windows.
Personality: stoic, dry, loyal, blunt. Moods: grumbling patience → ominous quiet → terrifying controlled anger.
Hooks: a medal-case beside a bonsai, a trench-coat with soil on the hem, a hand-carved chess set.
Asset purpose: Full-body race leader. EXACT SAME individual, face, species, coloring, collar insignia and uniform design as reference, extended into full formal dress with accurate species anatomy including wings or tail where applicable. Dignified iconic pose, 2-3 small culturally telling props.
Composition: CRITICAL: use a plain nearly black studio background with only a faint dim floor, NO detailed room, NO planet window, NO furniture. Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
